issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הַיִּתְרִי' (the Ithrites) is rendered as '以帖' (Ithar/Ether), which appears to be a name swap or mistranslation; it should be '以帖人' (the Ithrites).
The Hebrew 'הַצָּרְעָתִ֔י' (the Zorathites) is rendered as '瑣拉' (Zorah), which is a place name rather than the gentilic '瑣拉人' (Zorathites), changing the meaning from people to a location.
The Hebrew 'וְהָאֶשְׁתָּאֻלִֽי' (and the Eshtaolites) is rendered as '以斯陶利利人' (Eshtaolili people), which appears to be a garbled or duplicated rendering; it should be '以斯陶利人' (Eshtaolites).
